verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS meeting-notes product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence describes a self-hosted, on-prem, or downloadable deployment of Fellow. The API, MCP server and retention policies all run against Fellow's hosted service at {subdomain}.fellow.app, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
